# Simulated data


```{r}
X3 <- rnorm(n3, mu_true[3], sigma_true[3])
```

# Monte Carlo simulation

Both bootstrap calibrations below use the signed square root of the
adjusted EL statistic to test $H_0: \mathrm{VUS} = 1/6$ against
$H_1: \mathrm{VUS} > 1/6$.
Run the simulation setup and either interface interactively to reproduce the
5,000 replicates. Each dataset has 30 independent standard normal observations
per class. Both interfaces use the same datasets and bootstrap seeds.

```{r vus-null-data, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(35)
vus_null_data <- replicate(5000L, matrix(rnorm(90L), ncol = 3L),
                           simplify = FALSE)
alpha_levels <- c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01)
```

## Default method
```{r, eval=FALSE}
out_vus_MC <- lapply(seq_along(vus_null_data), function(i) {
  null_sample <- vus_null_data[[i]]
  out_vus_temp <- vus(x = null_sample[, 1], y = null_sample[, 2],
                      z = null_sample[, 3], vus0 = 1 / 6,
                      alternative = "greater", B = 500,
                      seed = length(vus_null_data) + i)
  r_mean <- 1/mean(out_vus_temp$r.bts)
  ll_val_mean <- r_mean * out_vus_temp$ll.value
  ll_val_med <- out_vus_temp$ll.value * out_vus_temp$r.adj
  signed_root_mean <- sign(out_vus_temp$estimate - 1/6) * sqrt(max(0, ll_val_mean))
  p_val_mean <- pnorm(signed_root_mean, lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_val_med <- out_vus_temp$p.value
  return(list(ll_val_mean = ll_val_mean, ll_val_med = ll_val_med, 
              p_val_mean = p_val_mean, p_val_med = p_val_med))
})
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
p_val_mean_MC <- vapply(out_vus_MC, `[[`, numeric(1), "p_val_mean")
hist(p_val_mean_MC)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
p_val_med_MC <- vapply(out_vus_MC, `[[`, numeric(1), "p_val_med")
hist(p_val_med_MC)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sapply(alpha_levels, function(x) mean(p_val_mean_MC <= x))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sapply(alpha_levels, function(x) mean(p_val_med_MC <= x))
```

## Formula method
```{r, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
out_vus_form_MC <- lapply(seq_along(vus_null_data), function(i) {
  null_sample <- vus_null_data[[i]]
  data_test <- data.frame(biom = c(null_sample),
                          diag = rep(c("1", "2", "3"), each = nrow(null_sample)))
  out_vus_temp <- vus(formula = biom ~ diag, data = data_test, vus0 = 1 / 6,
                      alternative = "greater", B = 500,
                      seed = length(vus_null_data) + i)
  r_mean <- 1/mean(out_vus_temp$r.bts)
  ll_val_mean <- r_mean * out_vus_temp$ll.value
  ll_val_med <- out_vus_temp$ll.value * out_vus_temp$r.adj
  signed_root_mean <- sign(out_vus_temp$estimate - 1/6) * sqrt(max(0, ll_val_mean))
  p_val_mean <- pnorm(signed_root_mean, lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_val_med <- out_vus_temp$p.value
  return(list(ll_val_mean = ll_val_mean, ll_val_med = ll_val_med, 
              p_val_mean = p_val_mean, p_val_med = p_val_med))
})
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
p_val_mean_form_MC <- vapply(out_vus_form_MC, `[[`, numeric(1), "p_val_mean")
hist(p_val_mean_form_MC)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sapply(alpha_levels, function(x) mean(p_val_mean_form_MC <= x))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
p_val_med_form_MC <- vapply(out_vus_form_MC, `[[`, numeric(1), "p_val_med")
hist(p_val_med_form_MC)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
sapply(alpha_levels, function(x) mean(p_val_med_form_MC <= x))
```
